mod.spatial-gui.name: Spatial GUI
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.title: Spatial GUI Config
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.firstPer: Use first person camera mode for the inventory screen
Use first person camera mode for non-inventory screens
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.autoDete: Automatically detect camera mode from current perspective
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.override:
Override the vanilla GUI scale with a custom value
WARNING: Can cause compatibility issues
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.guiScale: Custom GUI scale when override is enabled (1-6)
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.pauseScr: Enable Spatial GUI for the pause menu
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.allScree:
Enable Spatial GUI for every other screen while in a world
WARNING: EXPERIMENTAL
If a modded screen is broken, put it in disabled screens
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.inventor: Enable for the survival and creative inventory
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.containe:
Enable for chests, furnaces, crafting tables, villager trading, etc.
Includes most modded ones
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.autoScal: Automatically adjust screen scale, distance, and side offset based on your FOV setting
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.mirrorTh: Mirror the camera and screen position/rotation in third person mode
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.hideHotb: Hide the hotbar when a screen is open
Hide HUD elements (including the hotbar) when a screen is open
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.autoScal: FOV value that results in no scaling adjustment
Reduces the effect of FOV scaling on side offset
Adjusts the effect of FOV scaling on camera distance
Auto Scale Third Person Screen Multiplier
Reduces FOV scaling effect on third person screen scale
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.useAniso: Enable anisotropic filtering for better texture quality
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.enableWo: Make the screen brighter in sunlight and dimmer in caves or at night
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.lighting: How much the lighting affects the screen brightness (0-120)
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.recipeBo: Amount to shrink the screen when recipe book is open
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.hideHand: Hide player hands when in first person mode
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.hideShie: Hide the players shield when in first person mode
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.swingArm: Swing the player's arm when clicking items in first person mode
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.dropShad: Render a drop shadow behind the screen
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.renderSc:
Resolution scale for the GUI (25-100%).
Lower values improve performance, but look worse visually.
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.blurWorl:
Blurs the world behind the spatial screen, keeping the hand, HUD and player model sharp
EXPERIMENTAL
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.worldBlu:
How strong the blur of the world behind the screen is (1-10)
EXPERIMENTAL
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.screenDi: Distance of the screen from the player
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.screenSc:
Scale multiplier for the screen
WARNING: Values too large may cause mouse tracking to fail
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.cameraSi: Horizontal offset from the player (-4 to 4)
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.cameraHe: Vertical offset from the player (-4 to 4)
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.transiti: Duration of the camera transition animation
Skip percentage of transition to avoid clipping
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.avatarBa: Base yaw offset for the player avatar's head
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.avatarBo: Rotation offset for the player avatar's body
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.avatarMa: Maximum yaw rotation for the player avatar's head
Maximum pitch rotation for the player avatar's head
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.mirrorHe: Mirror the head movement in third person mode
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.lerpXRot: Smoothly interpolate camera pitch during transition
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.fallback: Fallback to First Person on Block Collision

Switch to first-person mode if third-person camera is obstructed by blocks.
When disabled, camera distance is adjusted to avoid clipping into blocks.
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.lerpCame:
Lerp the camera pitch.
Only when opening from Minecraft's third person perspective
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.firstPer: Screen horizontal offset from the camera
Screen vertical offset from the camera

Scale multiplier for the screen
WARNING: Values too large may cause mouse tracking to fail
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.curvedSc: Render the first person screen as a semi-cylinder wrapping around the camera

Total arc angle of the curved screen (5-150).
Higher values wrap the screen further around the camera
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.keepFirs:
Keep the camera angle when closing the GUI
WARNING: This affects your server-side rotation 
and may be disallowed by servers
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.useCross: Manually control the camera and use the crosshair for interacting, only in first person
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.lockFirs: Limit how far the first person camera can turn side to side to 180 degrees
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.firstPer: Maximum pitch angle for first person screen spawning
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.enableFa: Enable fade animation when opening inventory screens
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.enableCl: Enable a reverse animation when closing inventory screens
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.enableSc: Enable scale animation when opening inventory screens
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.animatio: Starting scale as percentage of final scale
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.override: Override the game's FOV when a screen is open
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.targetFo: Target FOV value when override is enabled (30-110)
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.fovLerpS: Speed of FOV transition (0 is instant, higher is slower)
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.seenScre:
Class names of every screen you've opened.
Copy a name from here into Enabled Screens or Disabled Screens.
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.enabledS:
Full class names of other screens to show as a 3D plane.
Works with modded screens.
Does not override the Inventory, Containers or Pause Screen toggles.
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.disabled:
Full class names of screens that should never use Spatial GUI.
This takes priority over everything else.
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.disableF: Disable Spatial GUI when in first person camera mode
yacl3.config.spatial-gui:config.disableT: Disable Spatial GUI when in third person camera mode
